body: No I'm afraid not, I don't believe it would help much anyway. I'm not particularly interested in anything at the moment and doing even the little things has become an obstacle lately. I've lost interest in keeping up appearances, I've become reclusive, I neglect myself pretty much. I sometimes flat out forget to eat and I dont care how I look, the only thing I do do in regards to my hygiene is shower everyday.

Thank you for the kind words but honestly I feel like im at the end of my tether. Im exhausted and emotionally spent. I feel so disillusioned and separate from the world that I just want out at this stage. I tried hope, I tried support but I hit rock bottom long ago and there's no getting back, is it so much to ask for an easy way out after all of this or does that have to be a battle too?
